comparison.objective: Rotate manifold fittings to create a leak-free coolant route; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Plan and rotate multiple indexed fittings versus counterhold one adjustment screw while locking it.
comparison.success_condition: Coolant connectivity reaches the outlet with no open ends versus angular setting retained after repeated gripper actuation.
comparison.reason: Both involve rotational configuration, but network routing and locknut setting preservation are different abilities.
